notes.title: Patch v0.3.14 - Mouse Integration
notes.notes:
Additions

 Mouse Support
- You can now perform actions using the Left & Right Mouse Buttons!
- There is an option that can be toggled in the menu that allows you to change whether or not you want to attack towards the mouse, or in front of the player.
 Area 1 Boss Theme is up
 Miracle activation SFX is up


Changes

 Controls
 - Default controls have been updated to be more Keyboard & Mouse friendly. If you have already changed these controls but want to try out the new layout, “Reset” your controls to gain access to them.
 End of Playtest Form
 - Once you’ve complete the playtest, there is a prompt directing you towards the feedback form. (this is critical for us to improve the game as much as possible)
 Oath Book Emblems that indicate which Upgrades have and have not been selected before
 “Light Attack” and “Heavy Attack” have been changed to “Normal Attack” and “Special Attack”


Coming Soon - v0.3.16

 More SFX variations for the primary attack upgrades
 Updated VFX for the Dash
 Buffs to the Power Palm attacks
 Boss HP Bar



The next patch will be a bit smaller as we prepare for a few major improvements to make the game more replayable and exciting!

Our goal before the end of the year is to have the second area playable (minus the boss fight). We really want to make sure you, the player, feel excited for every run.

Thank you for your support so far! Please look forward to future updates!

notes.title: Patch v0.3.13f1
notes.notes:
Changes


 Added Blessing/Curse icons to the Book of Oaths
 Added Soul Level explanation to the Book of Oaths


This is a quick patch just to see if the above improvements help players understand the UI more. We're still working on mouse integrations!

notes.title: Patch v0.3.13
notes.notes:
Additions

 Fly Traps have replaced the Thorn Bush traps in all Discord variations
 Area 1 Boss Fight has a proper end animation now / Un-Holy hitbox also adjusted


Changes

 Updated Objective colors to become clear when they have been cleared.
 Moved Meira to be more centered in the Hub / Also opened a prompt icon so players know you can talk to her


Bug Fixes

 Fixed the Discord link so it never expires
 Some enemies don’t function properly after Time Stop
 SFX pausing after defeating the final enemy in a wave during time stop
 Scarecrow Objective “Repeat Hit” has been fixed to account for all hits
 Omi’s death animations are now properly done


Coming Soon

 Mouse support to pair with keyboard controls (will be in the next patch)



The next patch will be exclusively for making sure Mouse clicks and binding are supported in the game! And any other bugs players find.

If you're interested, click on the Discord link on the Title Screen to stay up to date with all of the patches!

notes.title: Patch v.0.3.12f4
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

Changes

- The Miracle cool down has been shortened slightly
- Button prompts have a short description for what they do before interacting with them.
- Area 1 Boss Fight
  - Updated attack patterns
  - Increased dash speed

Bug Fixes

- UI -> Hub Objectives don’t have their check marks showing completion
- UI -> Gameplay - Hub objectives aren’t properly scaling across display resolutions
- Audio ->  Audio should no longer be “muted” randomly during gameplay.
- UI -> Damage Text for Enemies sometimes appears incorrectly

Coming Soon

- Mouse support to pair with keyboard controls


Thanks for the patience everyone!
- Baba
